m.x: This method performs the audio tag pooling logic. It first looks forunused audio tag to assign to this sound object. If there are no unusedaudio tags, based on HTML5AudioSoundManager#override property value, itlooks for sound with most advanced playback and hijacks its audio tag ordoes nothing.

m.x: Play this sound, or a marked section of it.It always plays the sound from the start. If you want to start playback from a specific timeyou can set 'seek' setting of the config object, provided to this call, to that value.If you want to play the same sound simultaneously, then you need to create another instanceof it and play that Sound. For HTML5 Audio this also requires creating multiple audio instanceswhen loading the audio files.
